chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:
"Perform the ritual bath (ghusl) on Friday, unless you are ill or fear for yourself."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing ghusl on Friday in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Friday ritual bath (ghusl al-Jumu'ah) as a highly recommended act (mustahabb) rather than an absolute obligation, evidenced by the specific exemptions for illness or fear of harm. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the principle of *raf' al-haraj* (removal of hardship), allowing flexibility for those whose health or strength would be compromised by the ritual washing.
